Stream=stream;
 (async()=>{let idle;try{const res=await fetch(n.base.replace(/\/$/,'')+'/api/rooms/'+n.id+'/events',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+n.token,'Last-Event-ID':String(n.revision)},signal:stream.abort.signal,cache:'no-store'});if(!res.ok||!res.body?.getReader)throw Error('Realtime fallback unavailable.');const reader=res.body.getReader(),decoder=new TextDecoder();let buffer='';idle=setInterval(()=>{if(performance.now()-stream.last>25000)stream.abort.abort();},5000);while(roomStream===stream&&network===n){const chunk=await reader.read();if(chunk.done)break;stream.last=performance.now();buffer+=decoder.decode(chunk.value,{stream:true});if(buffer.length>2000000)throw Error('Oversized realtime frame.');let end;while((end=buffer.indexOf('\n\n'))>=0){const message=buffer.slice(0,end);buffer=buffer.slice(end+2);const data=message.split('\n').filter(l=>l.startsWith('data:')).map(l=>l.slice(5).trimStart()).join('\n');if(data&&network===n)applyRoomState(JSON.parse(data));}}}catch(e){if(network===n)n.error='Realtime fallback interrupted; reconnecting.';}finally{clearInterval(idle);if(roomStream===stream){roomStream=null;if(network===n)pollTimer=setTimeout(pollRoom,1500);}}})();}
function ensureRoomStream(){const n=network;if(!n||roomStream?.session===n)return;stopRoomStream();if(String(n.state?.realtime||'polling')==='polling')return;const supportsWS=typeof WebSocket==='function'&&String(n.state?.realtime||'').includes('websocket')&&(n.wsFailures||0)<2;if(!supportsWS){startSSE(n);return;}try{const u=new URL(n.base);u.protocol=u.protocol==='https:'?'wss:':'ws:';u.pathname='/ws/rooms/'+n.id;u.search='';u.hash='';const ws=new WebSocket(u.href,['gomoku.v56','token.'+n.token]),stream={kind:'ws',session:n,ws,last:performance.now()};roomStream=stream;ws.onopen=()=>{if(network===n){n.transport='WebSocket';n.error='';renderRoomDetails();}};ws.onmessage=event=>{if(roomStream!==stream||network!==n)return;stream.last=performance.now();try{applyRoomState(JSON.parse(event.data));}catch{n.error='Invalid realtime state; reconnecting.';ws.close();}};ws.onerror=()=>{};ws.onclose=()=>{if(roomStream!==stream)return;roomStream=null;if(network===n){n.wsFailures=(n.wsFailures||0)+1;n.error=n.wsFailures>=2?'WebSocket unavailable; using SSE fallback.':'WebSocket interrupted; reconnecting.';pollTimer=setTimeout(pollRoom,500);}};}catch{n.wsFailures=2;startSSE(n);}}
function networkOpeningMove(i){const st=network?.state,info=st?.openingInfo;if(!info)return false;if(network.role!=='player'||network.state.you.seat!==(info.actor==='A'?1:2)){toast('Wait for the other player’s opening decision.');return true;}if(!['place','offer','choose'].includes(info.stage)){toast('Use the opening decision controls.');return true;}sendRoom({action:'opening',decision:'place',value:i});return true;}
function renderNetworkOpening(){const host=$('networkOpening');if(!host)return;const info=network?.state?.openingInfo;host.hidden=!info;if(!info){host.replaceChildren();return;}host.replaceChildren();host.append(text('h3','Opening · '+network.state.protocol),text('p',info.label,'muted'),text('p','Both players decide the opening. The playing clock starts after these decisions.','tiny'));const own=network.role==='player'&&network.state.you.seat===(info.actor==='A'?1:2),actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='button-row';const add=(label,decision,value)=>{const b=button(label,()=>sendRoom({action:'opening',decision,value}));b.disabled=!own||roomRequest;actions.append(b);};
 if(['swap','choice'].includes(info.stage)){add('Keep colors','keep');add('Swap colors','swap');if(info.stage==='choice')add('Offer ten points','ten');}if(['swap2choice','swap2final'].includes(info.stage)){add('Choose Black','color',1);add('Choose White','color',2);if(info.stage==='swap2choice')add('Place two more','extend');}if(info.stage==='count')for(let n=1;n<=8;n++)add(String(n)+' offer'+(n>1?'s':''),'count',n);if(network.state.opening.offers?.length){host.append(text('p','Proposals: '+network.state.opening.offers.map(coord).join(', '),'tiny'));if(info.stage==='choose')for(const i of network.state.opening.offers)add(coord(i),'place',i);}host.append(actions);}
function renderNetworkClock(){if(!network?.state?.clock?.enabled)return;const c=network.state.clock,remaining=c.remaining.slice(),elapsed=Math.max(0,performance.now()-(network.receivedAt||performance.now()));if(c.running)remaining[c.side]=Math.max(0,remaining[c.side]-elapsed);$('clockStrip').hidden=false;$('blackClock').textContent=clockString(remaining[1]);$('whiteClock').textContent=clockString(remaining[2]);$('blackClockBox').classList.toggle('active',c.side===1&&c.running);$('whiteClockBox').classList.toggle('active',c.side===2&&c.running);const pause=$('clockToggle');if(pause){pause.disabled=true;pause.textContent='Server clock';}}
insert('panel-play','<section class="platform-launch"><h2 class="eyebrow">PRIVATE ONLINE</h2><p class="tiny">Create or join an invite-only two-player room. No public matchmaking.</p><button class="btn ghost wide" id="platformBtn">Open private room</button></section>');document.querySelector('.board-top').insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin','<section id="networkOpening" class="platform-card" hidden></section>');$('platformBtn').onclick=openOnline;

async function loadOpeningDB(){if(openingDB)return openingDB;if(!bookLoad)bookLoad=(async()=>{try{const raw=await openingStore.get();if(raw){openingDB=O.validate(raw);bookMessage='Opening corpus restored from IndexedDB.';}}catch(e){bookMessage='Persistent opening storage is unavailable in this browser context. Imported records remain in memory; export a database backup.';}return openingDB;})();return bookLoad;}
function bookSummaryText(){if(!openingDB)return bookMessage;const s=O.summary(openingDB),years=s.firstYear?(s.firstYear===s.lastYear?String(s.firstYear):s.firstYear+'–'+s.lastYear):'dates unknown';return bookMessage+' '+s.records.toLocaleString()+' records · '+s.positions.toLocaleString()+' indexed positions · '+s.sources+' sources · '+s.knownResults.toLocaleString()+' known results · '+year
